posts.title: Light Dumbbells Build Muscle Too
posts.caption:
Light dumbbells build muscle too. Here's what the research says.

A review of studies found light and heavy weights built similar muscle when sets were taken close to failure (Schoenfeld et al., 2017). Effort beats plate size.

Save this before you buy heavier weights. 👇

posts.title: The Truth About 10,000 Steps
posts.caption:
10,000 steps a day isn't magic. It started as a pedometer ad.

Research shows benefits level off around 8,000 to 10,000 steps for adults under 60 (Paluch et al., The Lancet Public Health, 2022). Beat last week's average instead.

What's your daily average right now? 👇
